title: Bouncy Boots
hook: Boots 的靴子不见了，他要一路跳过大门口、过小河，去鞋店里一双一双地找，才能找回自己的靴子。

cells.en: “I can't wait to get my boots back, Dora,” says Boots.
cells.cn: “我迫不及待想拿回我的靴子了，Dora。”Boots 说。

cells.en: “Right, son diferentes.” These red boots are not his.
cells.cn: “对，它们不一样（son diferentes）。”这双红靴子不是他的。

cells.en: Dora's cards show the gates, the river and the shoe shop.
cells.cn: Dora 的卡片上是：大门、小河，还有鞋店。

cells.en: Boots bounces down the path and sings, “Boing, boing, boing!”
cells.cn: Boots 沿着小路一蹦一跳，唱着“Boing, boing, boing！”

cells.en: “I'll have to jump really, really high to reach the key.”
cells.cn: “我得跳得高高的，才能拿到那把钥匙。”

cells.en: “I'm gonna have to jump really, really, really high!” says Boots.
cells.cn: “这次我得跳得超级超级高！”Boots 说。

cells.en: “If the nuts are up or if the nuts are down?” Dora asks Tico.
cells.cn: “果子在上面，还是在下面？”Dora 问 Tico。

cells.en: “Are they Boots' boots?” Dora looks at the boots on the shelf.
cells.cn: “这是 Boots 的靴子吗？”Dora 看着货架上的靴子。

cells.en: At last Boots has his boots, and everyone smiles at the shop.
cells.cn: 最后 Boots 拿回了自己的靴子，大家在鞋店门口都笑了。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Bouncy Boots”.
ending: In the end, Boots gets his bouncy boots back and bounces all the way home. My favorite part is ______.
